column1: # OCTOPATH TRAVELER II 1.1.1; user-supplied ExeFS/RomFS and shader tables.
# No game files or derived shader payloads are distributed with this profile.
# patches.py and hle_uemalloc.c replace the 37 GiB FMallocBinned3 pools.
# Trim SDK nodes to 62 MiB and large-region alignment to 32 MiB; UE gets 4064 MiB in a 5 GiB host block.
# Static splitting accepts complete u32-sized raw LZ4 blocks starting at LSLG-1/-2; external history is not used.
# First NVN build captures headlessly when no complete snapshots exist, including when static shaders were found.
# Bounded first-run prompts toward the title/New Game screen; DM_KEYS seconds start with the Mac host.
